description: This file defines the class PojoNativeCodeProducer, which extends PojoCodeProducer, responsible for generating native C code (headers and source files) for POJO classes defined in Java. It consolidates templates, dependency management, and method to produce encoding, decoding, creating, destroying, and getter/setter functions for POJOs in C, tailored for native code integration.

classes.name: PojoNativeCodeProducer
classes.description: A class responsible for generating native C code (header and source files) from Java POJO definitions, including functions for encoding, decoding, creating, destroying, and managing POJO memory lifecycle.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main entry point to generate native code files, which calls generateNativeHeaderFile and generateNativeSourceFile.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Stub method indicating wrapper file generation is not applicable for native code.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Stub method indicating wrapper buffer generation is not applicable for native code.

methods.name: generateNativeHeaderFile
methods.description: Creates the .h header file defining enums, POJO structs, and function prototypes for native code.

methods.name: generateNativeSourceFile
methods.description: Creates the .c source file implementing create, destroy, encode, decode functions for POJOs.

methods.name: generateNativePojoDefs
methods.description: Generates typedefs for POJOs in the header file, handling dependencies, enums, and structs.

methods.name: generateNativePojoFunction
methods.description: Generates encode/decode/create/destroy function implementations or prototypes for POJOs.

methods.name: generateNativeEncode
methods.description: Creates the encode function for a given POJO, either as a prototype or implementation.

methods.name: generateNativeDecode
methods.description: Creates the decode function for a given POJO, either as a prototype or implementation.

methods.name: generateNativeCreate
methods.description: Creates the create function implementation or prototype for a POJO, initializing internal collections.

methods.name: generateNativeDestroy
methods.description: Creates the destroy function implementation or prototype for a POJO, freeing internal resources.

methods.name: generateNativeListDestroy
methods.description: Generates destroy function for a linked list POJO.

methods.name: generateNativeMapDestroy
methods.description: Generates destroy function for a map POJO.

methods.name: generateNativeGetters
methods.description: Generates getter functions for array/map variables within the POJO.

methods.name: generateNativeSetters
methods.description: Generates setter functions for array/map variables within the POJO.
